summary: 1963 30-ft steel tower replacing a 1941 CCC cab on Eightmile Mesa, San Juan NF, Archuleta County, CO; NHLR-registered 2011; trail guide says closed to public.

facts.design: 30-foot steel tower with CL-100-series cab and catwalk

access.note: Trail guide (onX) says the current tower is closed to the public and put in service only when needed; no agency statement about access was found

visit.trail_note: Forest Road 651A is one vehicle wide and gets muddy in rain; the trail guide says the view from the tower base is worth the drive; no source says whether the tower may be climbed

events.note: First lookout: 14-by-14-foot wooden cab built by CCC crews; onX gives a 20-foot wood frame
Current 30-foot steel tower with CL 100-series cab replaced the first; NHLR's Built field gives 1963
Registered August 17, 2011 as US 912, CO 17; nominated by Kent Argow
NHLR condition note: tower excellent and needs no work; cab in good condition

corrections.why: The 1963 date is the Built field for the current steel tower. The register's own description, West Lookouts and onX all date the first cab to 1941.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field gives 1963, but its description, West Lookouts and onX all date the first lookout to 1941 and the 1963 tower as its replacement.
Only onX gives a height for the 1941 tower (20-foot wood frame). The 30-foot figure belongs to the 1963 steel tower in all sources.

notes_for_editor: Two registers agree on design and dates. The access statement rests only on onX, a trail-guide site, so confirm with the San Juan NF Pagosa Ranger District. No staffing history or notable fires found in the sources read. NHLR Lookout.aspx?id=915 returned HTTP 500 and was not used. No rental listing found. A search result about a prescribed fire on Eight Mile Mesa was not read and is not used.
